en.title: Shift in question
en.summary: The focus moves from defining AGI to asking what can happen after AGI.
en.explanation: This matters because the paper studies possible paths for continued intelligence growth, not only whether AGI is possible.
en.boundary_notes: This does not claim ASI is guaranteed. It defines the research question.

zh.title: 问题重心转移
zh.summary: 关注点从定义 AGI 转向追问 AGI 之后还可能发生什么。
zh.explanation: 这很重要，因为论文研究的是智能继续增长的可能路径，而不只是 AGI 是否可能出现。
zh.boundary_notes: 这里并不是断言 ASI 必然出现，而是在界定研究问题。

en.title: Digital intelligence advantage
en.summary: Speed, replication, and coordination are key reasons digital systems may exceed a single human mind.
en.explanation: The advantage is not only higher IQ. It is also the ability to scale computation and organization.
en.boundary_notes: Real bottlenecks may still come from data, energy, environment interaction, and goal setting.

zh.title: 数字智能的优势
zh.summary: 速度、复制和协同，是数字系统可能超越单个人类心智的重要原因。
zh.explanation: 优势不只是更高的智商，还包括计算和组织方式可以规模化。
zh.boundary_notes: 现实瓶颈仍可能来自数据、能源、环境交互和目标设定。

en.title: Worker as execution boundary
en.summary: The Worker is replaceable and should not contaminate core data contracts.
en.explanation: Codex is useful now because it can execute tasks. Later, a script or background service should consume the same task and result contracts.
en.boundary_notes: A Worker may orchestrate and validate, but should not silently rewrite paper facts or user understanding state.

zh.title: Worker 作为执行边界
zh.summary: Worker 是可替换执行节点，不应该污染核心数据契约。
zh.explanation: Codex 现在有用，是因为它能执行任务。以后脚本或后台服务也应该消费同一套任务与结果契约。
zh.boundary_notes: Worker 可以编排和校验，但不能静默改写论文事实或用户理解状态。
